changelog:
- Initial release of ai-proposal-freelance-deal-generator.
- Generates personalized freelance proposals, pricing strategies, objection handlers, and follow-up messages for platforms like Upwork and Fiverr.
- Supports tiered outputs: FREE (short proposal only), PRO (adds full proposal, pricing, objections), GROWTH (adds follow-ups and proposal variations), PREMIUM (adds upsell/retainer/agency scripts).
- Customizes proposals based on user-supplied inputs: service, target client, job description, experience, pricing, tone, and tier.
- Output structured for real-world sales scenarios, with writing rules ensuring every response feels confident and human.
